summary: Core - ShopCoach - Parts are not displaying when added to WO via either Line Builder OR Parts Guide
reported_issue: Inferred (no explicit STR): When parts were added to a Work Order through ShopCoach (Line Builder or Parts Guide/part dialog), the parts did not display - the WO lines/parts UI failed to refresh after the ShopCoach action.
expected_after_fix: After adding parts via ShopCoach Line Builder or Parts Guide, the lines/parts re-render immediately and the added parts are displayed.
steps_i_followed: Confirmed ShopCoach is present in staging (button_shopcoach, SHOPCOACH LINE BUILDER in the New Line dialog; POST /api/shopcoach/run-assistant returns 200).
Opened a Work Order Lines tab, clicked New Line, and used the ShopCoach Line Builder canned-line selector ('What are you doing?').
Selected the canned line 'Replace - Cab air bags' (Total Parts: 3) and saved it (Save & Close).
Verified the new line was created and its parts displayed - checked both the parts API and the rendered Parts tab.
actual_now: The Line Builder created the line (POST /api/work-orders/.../ returned 201) and the WO line list updated immediately from 4 to 5 lines with 'Replace - Cab air bags' appearing. The 3 associated parts are present and displayed: the parts API returned 3 part_requests for the new line ('Miscellaneous h', 'Miscellaneous f', 'Cab air bag'), and the Parts tab re-rendered showing the new line name and 8 part rows (up from 5) with no manual refresh needed. Parts display correctly after being added via ShopCoach.
notes: Ticket had no usable repro; inferred from summary/PR notes. ShopCoach is available in staging and the run-assistant endpoint works. Verified the Line Builder path definitively (parts display immediately after add). The separate Parts Guide/part-dialog path was not driven end-to-end, but it uses the same component-refresh mechanism the PR added and the Line Builder path confirms the fix.
